paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance changes of Recall@50 and NDCG@50 with respect to the depth of search. The x-axis represents the depth of search, labeled without a specific unit, with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, and tick labels at each integer value. The left y-axis represents Recall@50, with a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis represents NDCG@50, with a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.35, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot includes four lines: Recall@50 (Ours) in solid green, starting at approximately 0.36 and increasing to around 0.57, Recall@50 (ReFICR) in dotted green, remaining constant at approximately 0.33, NDCG@50 (Ours) in solid blue, starting at around 0.22 and increasing to approximately 0.27, and NDCG@50 (ReFICR) in dotted blue, remaining constant at around 0.12. The solid green and blue lines exhibit an upward trend across the x-axis, with the green line showing a more pronounced increase, while the dotted green and blue lines remain steady throughout.
